scripts.check: bun --cwd app check && bun run check:server
scripts.tauri:dev: bun --cwd app build && bun --cwd tauri dev
scripts.tauri:build: bun --cwd app build && bun run server:compile && bun --cwd tauri build
scripts.tauri:build:mac: bun --cwd app build && bun run server:compile && bun --cwd tauri build:mac
scripts.tauri:build:win: bun --cwd app build && bun run server:compile && bun --cwd tauri build:win
scripts.tauri:build:portable: bun --cwd app build && bun run server:compile && bun run scripts/build-portable.ts
scripts.tauripad:build: bun --cwd app build && cargo build --manifest-path tauripad/Cargo.toml --target aarch64-apple-ios --release && cp tauripad/target/aarch64-apple-ios/release/libcoursedeck_ipad_lib.a tauripad/gen/apple/Externals/arm64/release/libapp.a && cp -R app/build/* tauripad/gen/apple/assets/
scripts.test: bun run test:unit && bun run test:mcp && bun run scripts/api-contract.ts && bun run scripts/sidecar-e2e.ts && bun run scripts/active-model-e2e.ts && bun run app/scripts/pdf-smoke.ts
